veld-ps-rondo-4-2.uitleg: Four players on the sides of the square keep the ball against two defenders. One defender presses the ball carrier, the other cuts off a passing lane. Whoever loses the ball (or plays it out) swaps with the defender who won it.
veld-ps-rondo-4-2.organisatie: 10 × 10 m square. One player on each side, two defenders in bibs in the middle.
coachpunten: Outside players: stay open and move so the passing lane doesn't run through a defender
Look for the split pass through the middle when the defenders are too far apart
Defenders: work together – one presses, the other covers the most dangerous lane
veld-ps-rondo-4-2.meerSpelers: With 7 players: add a middle player (5v2). With more: a second rondo.

veld-ps-rondo-5-2.uitleg: Four players on the sides and one in the middle keep the ball against two defenders. A pass through the middle player counts double. If a defender wins the ball, they swap with the player who lost it.
veld-ps-rondo-5-2.organisatie: 12 × 12 m square. Four players on the sides, one middle player (team A) and two defenders inside the square.
coachpunten: Middle player: stay behind the defenders and ask for the ball between the lines
Only pass to the middle player when they are open; otherwise move the ball first
Defenders: cover the middle player first, then press

moeilijker: When the defenders win it, they score by dribbling the ball out of the square

veld-ps-rondo-5-2.meerSpelers: With more players: a second rondo, or 6v3 in a bigger square.

veld-ps-4-4-2-jokers.uitleg: Two teams of four play inside a square; two jokers on the lines always play for the team in possession (6v4). Six passes in a row is a point. When the ball is lost, the jokers immediately play for the other team.
veld-ps-4-4-2-jokers.organisatie: 20 × 20 m square. Jokers (purple) in the middle of two opposite lines. Teams in bibs inside the square.
benodigdheden: bibs in 2 colours + 2 for the jokers
coachpunten: Make the pitch big when you have the ball: get wide and deep
Use the jokers to switch the ball to the free side
Press straight away when you lose the ball (transition)

moeilijker: A pass from joker to joker counts double

veld-ps-4-4-2-jokers.meerSpelers: With 11 or 12 players: 5v5 with 2 jokers. With more: extra jokers on the touchline.

veld-ps-5-5-2-jokers.uitleg: Two teams of five with two jokers on the pitch (7v5 in possession). Ten passes in a row is a point. If the ball goes out, the coach immediately plays a new ball to the other team.
veld-ps-5-5-2-jokers.organisatie: 28 × 22 m area. Jokers (purple) in the middle of the area. The coach stands outside the line with a pile of balls.
benodigdheden: bibs in 2 colours + 2 for the jokers
coachpunten: Find the free player: who has no opponent close by?
Make triangles around the ball carrier
Counting out loud helps the team stay calm

makkelijker: Jokers can move freely and take unlimited touches
moeilijker: After ten passes, also score in a mini goal

veld-ps-5-5-2-jokers.meerSpelers: With more players: jokers on the touchline, or rotate in 3-minute blocks.

veld-ps-eindzone.uitleg: Two teams of four. You score by receiving the ball in the other team's end zone: a teammate runs in and receives it in the zone. Then the other team gets the ball and attacks the other way.
veld-ps-eindzone.organisatie: 20 × 22 m pitch with a 4 m deep end zone at each end. Teams in bibs. Players may only enter the zone once the ball is played into it.
coachpunten: Give depth: always someone on the last line who can run in
Timing: only make your run when the ball carrier can pass
Defenders: cover the space behind you, not just the ball carrier

makkelijker: Dribbling into the zone also counts
moeilijker: The ball must be controlled with one touch in the zone
4 passes first, then you can score

veld-ps-eindzone.meerSpelers: With 9 players: a joker. With more: 5v5 in a bigger area, or a second pitch.

veld-ps-omschakelen.uitleg: The red team plays a rondo in square 1 against two blue defenders; the other two blues wait in square 2. When blue wins the ball, they play it straight into square 2 and both defenders sprint over: blue keeps the ball there, and two red players have to get across and press as quickly as possible.
veld-ps-omschakelen.organisatie: Two 10 × 10 m squares with 6 m between them. Four players per team. Red starts with four players on the sides of square 1, blue with two defenders in square 1 and two waiting players in square 2.
coachpunten: After winning the ball: first pass straight to the other square, before the opponents recover
After losing the ball: switch straight away and sprint across with two players
In square 2, get wide and open first, then keep it calmly

makkelijker: One red player presses instead of two
moeilijker: The long ball must be played on first time
A point for red if they win the ball back within 5 seconds

veld-ps-omschakelen.meerSpelers: With more players: jokers on the touchlines, or 5v5 in bigger squares.

veld-ps-door-de-linies.naam: Through the lines: playing from zone to zone
veld-ps-door-de-linies.uitleg: The red team has three players in zone 1 and three in zone 3; blue defends with three players in the middle zone. Red tries to play the ball through or round the middle zone to the other side. One blue player may press in the zone with the ball. Every successful pass to the other side is a point.
veld-ps-door-de-linies.organisatie: 20 × 30 m pitch divided into three 10 m zones. Red: 3 + 3 in the outside zones, blue: 3 in the middle. Swap roles after 2 minutes.
coachpunten: Move the ball quickly from left to right to open a gap in the middle zone
Play through the gap as soon as it opens: don't wait too long
Blue: shift across as a unit and keep the distances between you small

makkelijker: A lofted ball over the middle zone is also allowed
No blue player in the outside zone
moeilijker: The pass to the other side must be played on first time

veld-ps-door-de-linies.meerSpelers: With more players: an extra player per zone, or a joker on the touchline.

veld-cv-rondo-uitbreken.naam: 4v1 rondo and break out to goal
veld-cv-rondo-uitbreken.uitleg: Four players keep the ball in a square against one defender. After a few passes, the player on the goal side sprints out of the square, receives a through ball and finishes on the big goal.
veld-cv-rondo-uitbreken.organisatie: 8 × 8 m square 26 m from goal, keeper in goal. After 3–5 passes, the front player may break out. Whoever makes a mistake goes in the middle.
coachpunten: Rondo: stay open and play in two touches
Breaking out: only go when the ball is on the right side, then go flat out
Through ball into the run, not to feet

moeilijker: The defender may chase the runner
Finish within 6 seconds of breaking out

veld-cv-rondo-uitbreken.meerSpelers: With more players: a second rondo next to it, and the rondos take turns to break out.

veld-ps-rondo-4-2-uitbraak.uitleg: A 4v2 rondo in a square in front of goal. After 8 passes without losing the ball, the striker is played in behind and finishes against the keeper. If the defenders win the ball, they can score in a mini goal behind the square.
veld-ps-rondo-4-2-uitbraak.organisatie: 10 × 10 m square about 28 m from goal, mini goal 4 m behind the square. The striker waits diagonally in front of the square, on the goal side. Full-size goal with keeper.
coachpunten: Rondo: stay open, ball along the ground, in one or two touches
Through ball into the striker's path, not to feet
Striker: time your run (not too early), finish into the corner

moeilijker: A defender may chase the striker

veld-ps-rondo-4-2-uitbraak.meerSpelers: With more players: two rondos side by side that take turns to play the striker in, or two strikers.

veld-ps-3-3-3-spits.naam: 3v3 + 3 possession and play into the striker
veld-ps-3-3-3-spits.uitleg: Three teams of three in a square. The team in possession plays with the neutral team (6v3) against the third team. After 6 passes the ball may go into the striker, who waits outside the square and finishes against the keeper. When a team loses the ball, the team that wins it becomes the team in possession.
veld-ps-3-3-3-spits.organisatie: 16 × 16 m square about 22 m from goal. Three teams of three in different bibs, striker between the square and the goal. Full-size goal with keeper.
coachpunten: Get wide and deep: make the square big
Look before the ball arrives: where is the free player, where is the striker?
Striker: keep moving and get free as the sixth pass is played
veld-ps-3-3-3-spits.meerSpelers: With more players: 4v4 + 4, or two strikers who take turns.

veld-ps-5-tegen-3.uitleg: Five players keep the ball in the area against three defenders. Ten passes in a row is a point. If the defenders win the ball, they try to dribble it over one of the short sides: if they manage it, the point is theirs. Then the overload starts again.
veld-ps-5-tegen-3.organisatie: 16 × 22 m area. Five players in one colour, three defenders in bibs. 3-minute rounds; then three players swap roles.
veld-ps-5-tegen-3.meerSpelers: With more players: 6v3 in a bigger area, or a second area with the same game.
coachpunten: Make the area big: wide and deep, never two players in a line
Pass to the player furthest from a defender
Defenders: shift together, one presses and the others close the passing lanes

moeilijker: The defenders already score by playing the ball over a touchline

veld-ps-4-4-doelspelers.uitleg: Four against four in the area. Each team has two target players behind the lines: one at each end. Get the ball from one of your target players, through your teammates, to your other target player and it’s a point. The player who made the last pass swaps straight away with that target player: they go behind the line and the target player comes into the area.
veld-ps-4-4-doelspelers.organisatie: 18 × 26 m area. At both short ends, two target players stand behind the line, one from each team. 4-minute rounds.
veld-ps-4-4-doelspelers.meerSpelers: With more players: 5v5 with target players in a bigger area, or a neutral joker in the area.
coachpunten: Target player: shuffle along your line so you stay available
In the area: only play into the target player once you are facing them, not with your back to them
Join in straight after the swap: the new player has to be available immediately
Out of possession: press together and block the line to the target player, so the other team has to keep playing it sideways

makkelijker: Target players may also move inside the area
Every pass to a target player is a point
moeilijker: Only a point once everyone in the area has had the ball

veld-ps-vier-zones.uitleg: The area is split into four equal zones. The team in possession (four players, one per zone) tries to get the ball into all four zones: do it without losing the ball and it’s a point. Three defenders can go anywhere. The players in possession may switch zones, as long as there is always someone in every zone.
veld-ps-vier-zones.organisatie: 24 × 24 m area in four 12 × 12 m zones (marked with different coloured disc cones or cones). Four players against three defenders. 3-minute rounds.
veld-ps-vier-zones.meerSpelers: With more players: 5v3 with a joker who can go anywhere, or 6v4 in a bigger area.
coachpunten: Before your first touch, check which zone is still missing
Move the ball to the zone furthest from the defenders
Defenders: shutting off one zone is often enough

moeilijker: Zones in a fixed order (round the square)

veld-ps-7-tegen-5-opbouw.uitleg: Seven against five with a fixed build-up shape: two centre-backs, two full-backs out wide, two midfielders and a striker at the far end. The overload builds from the back and tries to reach the striker: every pass into the striker’s feet is a point. Fixed agreement: first use the centre-backs and full-backs to make the opponents shift, then go forwards through a midfielder.
veld-ps-7-tegen-5-opbouw.organisatie: 40 × 36 m area. Centre-backs on the back line, full-backs on the sides at 12 m, midfielders at 16 m, striker at 30 m. Five opponents in bibs. After a point or losing the ball, the ball starts again with a centre-back.
veld-ps-7-tegen-5-opbouw.meerSpelers: With more players: a keeper behind the centre-backs (8v5), or a second striker against an extra defender.
coachpunten: Keep width and depth: full-backs on the line, midfielders between the opponents
Move the ball until a midfielder is free, only then go forwards
Midfielder: receive half-turned so you can see the striker straight away

makkelijker: The full-backs may not be pressed
moeilijker: After winning the ball, the opponents score on two mini goals

veld-ps-rondo-4-2-wisselen.uitleg: A 4v2 rondo, but the outside players don’t stay put: after every pass, the passer swaps places with the outside player next to them who didn’t receive the ball. The passer goes round the outside, the other player cuts inside. That way everyone keeps having to look where the passing options are.
veld-ps-rondo-4-2-wisselen.organisatie: 10 × 10 m square. Four outside players on the sides, two defenders in bibs in the middle. Whoever loses the ball swaps with the defender who won it.
veld-ps-rondo-4-2-wisselen.meerSpelers: With 7 players: add a middle player (5v2). With more: a second rondo.
coachpunten: Swap straight after your pass, round the outside and quickly
If you cut inside: don’t run through the passing lane, check where the ball is first
The receiver checks where their teammates are now before the first touch

moeilijker: The passer chooses who to swap with

veld-ps-rondo-3-1-plus-1-1.uitleg: Three players keep the ball in a triangle against one defender. If the defender wins the ball, it immediately becomes a 1v1: they attack the mini goal, and the player who lost the ball has to defend it. Then they swap roles and the rondo starts again.
veld-ps-rondo-3-1-plus-1-1.organisatie: Triangle with 9 m sides (disc cones). Mini goal 8 m from the triangle. Three players and one defender in a bib.
veld-ps-rondo-3-1-plus-1-1.meerSpelers: With more players: two triangles, each with a mini goal, or 4v1 in a square.
coachpunten: Rondo: give two passing options, the ball in one or two touches
After losing the ball, switch straight away: you defend the goal
Defender: after winning it, dribble straight at the goal, don’t look round first

moeilijker: After winning it, the defender attacks two mini goals (choice)

veld-ps-opbouw-4-keeper-2.uitleg: The keeper starts with the ball. Two centre-backs and two midfielders build up together with the keeper against two opposing attackers. They score by passing or dribbling the ball into one of the two mini goals on the halfway line. If the attackers win the ball, they can shoot at the big goal straight away.
veld-ps-opbouw-4-keeper-2.organisatie: 40 × 32 m area with a full-size goal and keeper at one end and two mini goals on the other line (16 m apart). Centre-backs wide at 6 m, midfielders at 15 m, two attackers in bibs.
veld-ps-opbouw-4-keeper-2.meerSpelers: With more players: add two full-backs (6 + keeper against 3), or a third attacker.
coachpunten: Centre-backs: split wide so the attackers can’t screen both
Keeper: pass to the free defender, onto their far foot
Midfielder: get free behind the attackers and receive half-turned

makkelijker: The attackers may not press the keeper
moeilijker: Score in a mini goal within 10 seconds
The keeper may only use their feet

veld-ps-linies-diepe-spits.naam: Through the lines to a striker in behind
veld-ps-linies-diepe-spits.uitleg: Two centre-backs build up and have to get the ball through the middle zone to the striker. In the middle zone, two midfielders play against two opponents. The centre-backs move the ball until a midfielder is free; they open up and play the striker in behind, who takes on their defender and finishes.
veld-ps-linies-diepe-spits.organisatie: On half a pitch, in three zones: back zone (40–50 m) with two centre-backs, middle zone (26–40 m) with 2v2, front zone with the striker against one defender and a keeper. Players stay in their own zone, only the ball goes through the lines.
veld-ps-linies-diepe-spits.meerSpelers: With more players: 3v2 in the middle zone, or a second striker in the front zone.
coachpunten: Centre-backs: move the ball quickly until the line to a midfielder opens
Midfielder: stand in the gap between the opponents and open up
Striker: make your run as the midfielder looks up, deep into the space

makkelijker: One opponent in the middle zone
moeilijker: The midfielder must play it on first time
An opponent from the middle zone may track back

veld-tq-vrijlopen-rug-verdediger.naam: Getting free from behind the defender
veld-tq-vrijlopen-rug-verdediger.uitleg: The midfielder stands behind a defender, where the centre-back can’t pass to them. They get free by stepping out to the side from behind the defender, at the moment the centre-back looks up. They receive the ball, open up to face forwards and play the striker in behind, who makes a run into the space behind the last line and finishes.
veld-tq-vrijlopen-rug-verdediger.organisatie: On half a pitch. Centre-back with balls 44 m from goal, defender (bib) at 33 m, midfielder right behind them, striker diagonally to the right at 22 m. Keeper in goal. Rotate after each go.
coachpunten: Get free at the right moment: when the passer looks up, not before
Step out from behind the defender to the side where they can’t see you
Open up with your first touch and look in behind straight away

moeilijker: The defender may follow and press
Through ball first time after the turn
A second defender on the striker

veld-ps-rondo-twee-kleuren.uitleg: Six outside players in two colours stand round the area, alternating red and blue. You may only pass to someone of the other colour. The two chasers in the middle know this and try to read the passing lane. If a chaser wins the ball, they swap with the player who lost it.
veld-ps-rondo-twee-kleuren.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area. Six outside players (3 red, 3 blue) and two chasers in bibs. One ball. Rounds of 2 minutes.
veld-ps-rondo-twee-kleuren.meerSpelers: With more players: eight outside players and three chasers in a bigger area.
coachpunten: Before the ball arrives, know who of the other colour is free
Play away from the chasers, not through them
Move along the line to open up a passing lane

moeilijker: The coach changes the rule: same colour only

veld-ps-2-1-vier-vakjes.uitleg: Four boxes in a square, with two attackers against one defender in each box. After five passes without the defender touching the ball, play the ball on to the next box. That way the ball travels round the whole square. If a defender wins the ball, they swap with the player who lost it.
veld-ps-2-1-vier-vakjes.organisatie: Four 7 × 7 m boxes in a square, 2 m apart. Two attackers and a defender in each box. One ball (or two for experienced groups). New defenders after 4 minutes.
veld-ps-2-1-vier-vakjes.meerSpelers: With more players: a fifth box, or 3v1 in each box.
coachpunten: Stand at an angle to each other, never in line with the defender
After your pass, look straight away for a new angle
Passing on to the next box: firm and to feet

moeilijker: Pass on to the box diagonally opposite

veld-ps-balbezit-hoekvakken.uitleg: Four against four plus two jokers, who always play with the team in possession. In each corner of the pitch there is a small box. You score a point by passing to a teammate who runs into a corner box and controls the ball there. You may not wait in a corner box: only go in when the ball is coming.
veld-ps-balbezit-hoekvakken.organisatie: 24 × 24 m area with a 4 × 4 m box in each corner. Two teams of four and two jokers. After a point the team keeps the ball and plays towards another corner box.
veld-ps-balbezit-hoekvakken.meerSpelers: With more players: five against five plus two jokers in a bigger area.
coachpunten: Make the pitch big: always someone wide and deep
Only run into the corner box when the passer is ready to play
After a point, switch to the other side straight away

moeilijker: Only a point after a first-time pass

veld-ps-overtal-zijkant.uitleg: Six against four on a wide strip. The team of six moves the ball round and deliberately creates an overload on one side: three against two along the touchline. As soon as a player is free there, play them in and they dribble over the end line. If the team of four wins the ball, they score by dribbling over the other line.
veld-ps-overtal-zijkant.organisatie: 40 × 24 m strip. Six against four; each team scores by dribbling over the other team’s line. After 4 minutes two players change teams.
veld-ps-overtal-zijkant.meerSpelers: With more players: seven against five, or a third team that rotates in after each attack.
coachpunten: Draw the defenders to one side with short passes
Get three players around the ball: one deep, one wide, one short
Find the free player at the moment the defender has to choose

veld-ps-rondo-3-1-twee-vakken.uitleg: Three players keep the ball against one defender in the first box. After four passes, play the ball over to the empty box next to it; one player sprints there early to receive it and the other two follow. The defender must follow and starts hunting again in the new box. If the defender wins the ball, they swap with the player who lost it.
veld-ps-rondo-3-1-twee-vakken.organisatie: Two 8 × 8 m boxes side by side, 2 m apart. Three attackers and one defender in a bib. After 2 minutes the defender changes.
coachpunten: Stay available: stand beside the defender, not behind
The switch: one player is already on the way before the ball is played
Defender: switch quickly, straight into the new box

veld-ps-3-3-vier-kaatsers.uitleg: Three against three in the box, with a wall player on each side. The wall players play for the team in possession but stay on their line. Ten passes in a row (the wall players count too) is a point. If the other team wins the ball, the count starts again, for them.
veld-ps-3-3-vier-kaatsers.organisatie: 16 × 16 m box. Two teams of three in the box, four wall players in another colour, one on each side. Rounds of 3 minutes; then two wall players swap with a team.
veld-ps-3-3-vier-kaatsers.meerSpelers: With more players: 4v4 with four wall players, or a second box next to it.
coachpunten: Use the wall players to move the ball to the free side
Become available again straight after your pass
Wall player: one or two touches, to the player who is free

moeilijker: No passing back to the player who passed to you

veld-ps-opbouw-via-middenvak.naam: Building up through the middle zone
veld-ps-opbouw-via-middenvak.uitleg: Three zones. Red has three defenders in the first zone, one midfielder in the middle zone and two attackers in the last zone. Blue defends with two players in the middle zone and one in the last zone. The ball must go to the attackers via the midfielder: if it does, that is a point. A long ball over the middle zone does not count. Everyone stays in their own zone.
veld-ps-opbouw-via-middenvak.organisatie: 28 × 36 m area in three zones of 12 m. Red 6, blue 3. After a point or losing the ball, red starts again at the back. After 4 minutes the roles change.
veld-ps-opbouw-via-middenvak.meerSpelers: With more players: two midfielders against three in the middle zone, or an extra attacker.
coachpunten: Midfielder: keep moving until you are free, and check before the ball arrives
Defenders: move the ball quickly until the midfielder is free
Pass to the foot away from the defender

makkelijker: One blue player in the middle zone
moeilijker: The midfielder may only touch it twice
One blue player may press in the first zone

veld-ps-keeper-extra-man.naam: Positional play with the keeper as an extra player
veld-ps-keeper-extra-man.uitleg: Five against three on half a pitch, with the keeper as the free player at the back. Red starts with the keeper and tries to play out over the halfway line: dribble over it with the ball. You may always pass back to the keeper, so it is always six against three. If blue wins the ball, they may shoot at goal straight away.
veld-ps-keeper-extra-man.organisatie: On a 40 × 35 m half with a goal and keeper. Red 5 + keeper, blue 3. After a point or a goal, red starts again with the keeper. After 5 minutes three players change roles.
coachpunten: Keeper: offer yourself, and play quickly to the side with space
Make the pitch big: wide and deep
After a back pass: move the ball quickly to the other side
